capabilities: Send notes to Kindle via email
extras: Requires manual installation. Only supports local PNG, JPEG, and GIF images.
intentEvidence: Turn a note into a readable EPUB and send it to your Kindle through your own email account.
motivation: Write and collect articles in Obsidian, then read them later on your Kindle.
problem: Users want an easy way to transfer their collected Obsidian knowledge and notes into a format readable on their Kindle device.
summary: A tool that converts Obsidian notes into EPUB format and emails them to a Kindle device using a configured SMTP server.
